cases.name: a FENCED block is not a declaration, even at column zero
the decompose seeding snippet quoted in a body declares nothing (#3639)
cases.body:
Seeded with:

```bash
gh issue create --body "$(cat <<EOF
blocked-by: #99
scope: apps/console/**
EOF
)"
```

cases.name: an UNTERMINATED fence does not swallow a later declaration
a declaration AFTER a closed fence is still read
TWO declaration lines are unioned, not just the first
a list-item declaration is READ, not silently dropped
a bold declaration is READ, not silently dropped
duplicates collapse and the result is ascending
